title: Codec configuration guard
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $p$ specify an input-head position and a work-head position for each work tape, let $q$ be a codec case, and let $a$ assign a Boolean to each codec port. The assignment satisfies the guard for $p$ and $q$ precisely when the state, input-head, and every work-head port are true; reading the input-symbol port at the input-head position gives the input symbol in $q$; and, for each work tape, reading its two symbol ports gives the work symbol in $q$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
Codec positions for the input head and each work head
A Boolean assignment to every codec port
